title: Clone repository
description: Fetches a repository from a server or from another folder onto this computer.

authFailed.title: Sign-in rejected
authFailed.hint: The server didn't accept the user name, password, token or SSH key. Check your credentials – and whether you're allowed to read this repository at all.

offline.title: Server not reachable
offline.hint: Check the network connection, any proxy, and the server name in the address.

notFound.title: There is no repository at this address
notFound.hint: Check the spelling of the address and, if given, the branch. Private repositories respond the same way without the right permissions.

pathExists.title: The target is already taken
pathExists.hint: There is already a non-empty folder or a file there. Choose a different folder name or a different target folder.

pathNotFound.title: The target folder doesn't exist
pathNotFound.hint: Use “Browse …” to choose an existing folder.

hostKeyUnknown.title: SSH server not confirmed
hostKeyUnknown.hint: The server's fingerprint wasn't confirmed. Compare it with the details from the provider and confirm it on the next attempt.

timeout.title: No response from the server
timeout.hint: The connection made no progress for too long and was closed. Try again later.

branchMissing.title: This branch doesn't exist there
branchMissing.hint: Check the spelling, or leave the field empty to get the default branch.

errors.hostKeyChanged: The SSH server's key has changed
errors.noLeftovers: No half-finished folder was left behind.

phase.enumerating: The server is gathering the data
phase.compressing: The server is compressing the data

progress.label: Clone progress
progress.waiting: Waiting for the server to respond …

validation.parentNotAbsolute: Enter a full path or choose the folder with “Browse …”.
validation.parentMissing: Choose the folder in which the clone should be created.
validation.depth: The depth is a whole number of 1 or more.
validation.dateFormat: Write the date as year-month-day, e.g. 2026-01-31.
validation.dateMissing: Enter the date from which the history is fetched.
validation.sparseMissing: Name at least one folder – or turn off sparse checkout.

stillRunning.title: The clone is still running
stillRunning.body: If you cancel now, the incomplete folder is removed again. Your input is lost when the dialog closes.

cancelled.title: Clone cancelled
cancelled.body: The incomplete folder was removed again. Your input is still there.

url.label: Address
url.hint: HTTPS, SSH (git@host:group/project.git) or a local path.

parent.label: Target folder
parent.placeholder: Folder in which the clone is created

targetHint: Address and target folder together determine where the clone goes.

shallow.label: Shallow clone
shallow.hint: Fetches only the most recent part of the history – faster and smaller, older commits are missing.

branch.label: Branch
branch.hint: Leave empty to check out the default branch.

sparse.label: Sparse checkout
sparse.hint: Checks out only selected folders. Files in the root folder are always included.

parse.control: The address contains a control character.
parse.scheme: “{{scheme}}://” isn't supported here. Possible are https://, ssh://, git:// and file://.
parse.restMissing: The rest of the address is missing after “://”.
parse.hostMissing: The server name is missing from the address.
parse.pathMissing: The path to the repository is missing after the server name.
parse.scpPathMissing: The path to the repository is missing after the colon.
parse.incomplete: This isn't a complete address. Examples: https://host/group/project.git, git@host:group/project.git or a local path.
parse.portNotNumber: The server name is followed by “:{{port}}” – in an address with “{{scheme}}://” that is the port and must be a number. Separate the path with a slash (“{{scheme}}://host/path”).
parse.portNotNumberSsh: The server name is followed by “:{{port}}” – in an address with “{{scheme}}://” that is the port and must be a number. Separate the path with a slash (“{{scheme}}://host/path”) or use the short form “git@host:path”.
parse.portRange: Port {{port}} doesn't exist: ports range between 1 and 65535.

folderName.char: The character “{{char}}” isn't allowed in folder names.
folderName.control: The name contains a control character.
folderName.leadingSpace: The name can't start with a space.
folderName.trailing: The name can't end with a period or a space.
folderName.reserved: Windows reserves this name for itself.
folderName.tooLong: At {{length}} characters, the name is too long (at most {{max}}).

branchName.char: The character “{{char}}” isn't allowed in branch names.
branchName.sequence: “..” and “@{” aren't allowed in branch names.
branchName.slashes: Slashes only between parts of the name.
branchName.ending: The name can't end with “.” or “.lock”.
